seo.metaTitle: SVG to PNG - Free Converter, No Upload
seo.metaDescription: Rasterize an SVG into a PNG in your browser: paste the markup, set the size, download the bitmap. No upload of files, no account, no watermark.
seo.longDescription: Convert SVG to PNG rasterizes vector markup into a bitmap of the size you set: paste the SVG code, and the browser engine on your machine draws it into a PNG ready to download. This is what you need when a program does not draw SVG at all — an icon or a chart has to be handed over as pixels. The markup is rendered locally; no file is uploaded and no external asset referenced by the SVG is fetched.
facts: Renders with your browser's own SVG engine — curves, strokes and gradients come out as on a web page.
Runs entirely in your browser: the markup and the PNG never reach a server.
External images referenced by the SVG are not fetched from anywhere.
Free with no daily limit, no watermark and no account, also for commercial use.
howTo: Paste the SVG code into the text field on the left.
Set the output size in pixels; the drawing is scaled to fit.
Check the preview of the rasterized result.
Download the PNG from the Download button.

faq.q: Will the PNG look the same as the SVG?
faq.a: Yes, because the same browser engine that renders SVG on a web page renders it here. Curves, strokes, gradients and fonts supported by the browser are reproduced; features that only exist in a desktop editor are not part of SVG in the first place.
Export at the size it will be displayed, or at 2x that for a high-density screen. SVG scales without limit, so a bigger export costs file size but stays sharp.

Text is rendered with the fonts available to the browser. If the SVG does not embed its font and relies on a family you do not have, the preview shows a fallback - convert such text to outlines before rasterizing if the exact shapes matter.
No. The markup is rasterized in your browser tab, so the code never reaches a server. The same applies to any image the SVG references by URL: it is not fetched for you.
